I am a PhD student in Renewable Energy at IER-UNAM and a mechatronics engineer. My research focuses on heliostat control using computer vision and closed-loop correction, with experimental work on the heliostat and solar furnace at IER. My experience includes instrumentation, embedded systems, IoT and data analysis with Python.


## Education
- PhD in Renewable Energy — IER-UNAM (2026-present)
- Master's in Engineering - Energy Area — IER-UNAM (2022-2025)
- B.Eng. in Mechatronics — Universidad Tecnológica de Emiliano Zapata (UTEZ) (2018–2020)

## Experience
- Teaching Assistant — IER-UNAM (2023-present). Current support for Solar Thermal Energy, particularly solar geometry.
- Physics and Mathematics Teacher — NC School (2024–2025)
- IoT Developer — IER-UNAM (2020 / 2024-present)
- General co-coordinator of CNEER — National Congress of Renewable Energy Students (2026)

## Highlights
### Computer vision for heliostat control
Doctoral research on closed-loop heliostat control and correction, with experimental work on the heliostat and solar furnace at IER.
[Current research](proyectos.html#heliostato)


### IoT smartwatch for thermal comfort
Open design based on XIAO ESP32C3, MAX30102, GY‑906; LVGL UI and ThingsBoard backend.
